ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black pixels across approximately 85-90% of the visible surface, with localized high-intensity white/grey clusters at the distal tips and scattered high-contrast punctate spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A large central contiguous black region. Distinct high-contrast white/grey mottled regions are located at the extreme distal ends of both the left and right lobes. Multiple discrete high-intensity circular points are distributed semi-randomly across the dark ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible shallow V-shaped depression with a wide angle and moderate depth relative to the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude irregularities along the proximal trailing edge, transitioning to high-amplitude, jagged serrations at the distal tips due to textured encrustations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve originating at the median notch and sweeping outward and upward to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of irregular, high-relief white texture on the distal margins. Numerous individual circular white pixel clusters (1-5 pixels in diameter) are scattered across the dark central regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single thin, low-contrast linear disruption is visible on the right lobe, oriented diagonally from the interior toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological encrustations (barnacles) are present on the distal tips of both lobes, creating a significantly roughened and jagged edge profile.
